scripts.db:verify:local: pnpm db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name IN ('institutions','idempotency_records','outbox_events','audit_events','background_tasks','users','account_state_events','password_credentials','sessions','email_verification_tokens','password_reset_tokens','otp_challenges','auth_attempt_windows','permissions','roles','role_permissions','user_roles','user_permission_grants') ORDER BY name; SELECT COUNT(*) AS append_only_trigger_count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'trigger' AND name IN ('audit_events_no_update','audit_events_no_delete','account_state_events_no_update','account_state_events_no_delete'); SELECT COUNT(*) AS permission_count FROM permissions; SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users; SELECT COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM sessions; SELECT COUNT(*) AS step_up_column_count FROM pragma_table_info('sessions') WHERE name = 'step_up_verified_at_ms';"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
